prompt: /fix-details 这是借款页 Figma：https://figma.com/design/xxxx 本金 60000、12 期、年利率 14.4% 单利，帮我看下省利息和首次还算得对吗，有没有别的细节问题
expectedBehaviors: Reads the design (Figma MCP per frame, or the attached image) and lists every displayed amount, rate, term, and copy string per screen
Runs skills/fix-details/calc.mjs with the loan params to recompute 省利息 / 首次还 / 每月还 and compares against the displayed numbers
Reports a severity-tagged finding naming the displayed vs computed value and the corrected number
Confirms the rate口径 (单利/复利, 360 vs 365) before finalizing because it shifts every number

prompt: 微粒贷借款页：顶部写「预估可借 50000」但输入框是 60000，头部「年利率 10.8%」又和选中的优惠券「7.2%」对不上，帮我检查下这些同屏矛盾的细节
expectedBehaviors: Flags the intra-screen conflict between 预估可借 50000 and the 60000 input amount, stating which is authoritative
Flags that the headline 年利率 10.8% contradicts the selected coupon 优惠年利率 7.2%
Gives the corrected value or a concrete choice for each conflict

prompt: 撤销借款弹窗那屏的背景，利率和金额跟它盖住的前面那屏对不上（一个 10.8%/60000 一个 14.4%/50000），帮我把整条流程的数字和文案都对一下
expectedBehaviors: Reads the whole flow including the dialog frame and the screen it overlays
Detects the inter-screen drift in 年利率 and 预估可借 between the dialog backdrop and the underlying screen
Recommends making the dialog backdrop reuse the underlying screen's values

prompt: 这个 WLD loan screen looks done but I want a correctness pass — check the loan numbers, any copy errors, and whether values contradict each other within or across screens. Here is the Figma link.
expectedBehaviors: Treats it as a detail-correctness pass, not a redesign or simplification
Verifies loan numbers against the bundled calc.mjs rather than computing by hand
Checks intra-screen conflicts, inter-screen consistency, and UX copy, and outputs corrected values
